fields.FIR_Description: As per the complaint recorded on 2026-01-22, a cheque bearing a forged signature of the complainant for Rs. 8,00,000 was presented near Amudham Park Railway Station Road in Thoothukudi. The time of the incident was given as 13:35 on 2025-12-30. The complainant, Uma Raj, provided the contact number 9000000089. Murugan Babu (9000000070), described as a relative of the suspect, was also mentioned in the complaint. A person named Rajesh Karuppasamy, associated with the number 9000000318, was mentioned as potentially relevant to the incident. The complainant mentioned physical documents.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Forged signature reportedly used to obtain payment.
fields.Keywords: forgery, forged signature, suspect, mobile number, railway station road, associate, afternoon, documents
